pkgmetadata.longdescription: Skyvern is an AI-powered browser automation framework that uses LLMs and computer vision to automate browser-based workflows without fragile CSS selectors or XPaths. It can navigate websites, fill forms, extract data, and interact with complex web UIs through natural language instructions.

use.flag: Enable local/server mode with full browser automation, database support (PostgreSQL, SQLite), and all AI provider integrations
